title: fair-lending-test-plan
description: Structured second-line fair-lending test plan. Carries scope, in-scope decisioning models (including AI/ML), planned tests with method and demographic-proxy detail, less-discriminatory-alternative testing where models are in scope, controls hypothesis, committee approval gate, legal-privilege posture, and source trace. Downstream consumers: fair-lending committee deck, regulator response file, complaint-theme-analysis cross-link, adverse-action-review cross-link.

plan_id.description: Stable identifier for this test plan. Reused across the testing cycle and the result memo.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this plan was produced.

as_of_date.description: Date the plan was last revised.

risk_assessment_ref.description: Pointer to the underlying fair-lending risk assessment (annual or refreshed) that this plan operationalizes.

trigger.description: Why this plan is being produced. Drives depth and committee path.

products.description: Products in scope. Examples: first-lien-mortgage-purchase, first-lien-mortgage-refi, HELOC, indirect-auto, direct-auto, unsecured-personal, credit-card, small-business-credit, BNPL.

decision_points.description: Where in the credit lifecycle the plan tests. Marketing and steering precede underwriting; servicing and loss mitigation follow.

geographies.description: MSAs, assessment areas, states, or other geographic scoping.

channels.description: Origination and decision channels in scope. Examples: branch, digital, broker, dealer-indirect, third-party-marketing.

exclusions.description: Explicit out-of-scope items the plan will not cover.

prohibited_bases_tested.description: ECOA-protected bases and FHA-protected classes the plan tests against. Subset where data and proxy method support testing; flag the gap where they do not.

model_inventory_in_scope.description: Decisioning models the plan tests. Where any entry has ai_ml=true, the plan must include at least one test with lda_required=true.

decision_use.description: Where in the credit lifecycle the model is used. Examples: pre-screen, underwriting-score, pricing-tier, fraud-deny, marketing-targeting.

card_reference.description: Pointer to the model card (model-card-builder record) where one exists.

tests.description: Planned tests. One entry per test.

hypothesis.description: What the test is checking. State as a falsifiable hypothesis, not a generic objective.

method.description: Specification, sampling design, statistical approach. A regression with no model spec is not a plan.

demographic_proxy_method.description: Per-test choice. Justify when not the strongest available for the product (HMDA self-reported is stronger than BISG for mortgage).

demographic_proxy_caveats.description: Known limitations of the chosen proxy as it applies to this test population.

sample_size.description: Where applicable. Comparative file review and stratified samples carry an explicit n.

statistical_threshold.description: Examples: p < 0.05; standardized mean difference > 0.20; effect-size threshold from firm policy.

lda_required.description: Less-discriminatory-alternative testing required. True for any test where the in-scope decisioning model is AI/ML or where the disparate-impact theory is the operative theory.

lda_method.description: How the LDA search will be conducted: feature-removal sweep, threshold adjustment search, alternative model class, debiasing technique. Required when lda_required is true.

owner.description: Role of the first-line owner running the test.

escalation_path.description: Named committee or forum for results and escalation.

controls_hypothesis.description: First-line controls the plan is reading against. Examples: judgmental override review, pricing-exception log, LO-incentive design review, marketing-channel approval gate.

committee.description: Named committee that approves the plan. Examples: Fair Lending Committee, Consumer Compliance Committee, Risk Committee (where fair lending is brigaded under risk).

approval_criteria.description: What the committee is approving against.

legal_privilege_posture.description: Privilege posture for the plan and the resulting test memos. Set with counsel; do not assume.

open_questions.description: Items flagged for counsel, fair-lending statistician, or committee.

confidence_label.description: Confidence in the plan as drafted, per references/review-gates.md.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims (regulatory anchors, prior testing, complaint themes, supervisory observations).
